title: ligularia mosoyinensis
intro: Ligularia mosoyinensis, commonly known as the Korean angelica, is a perennial plant native to China and Korea. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Ligularia mosoyinensis include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of arthritis, fever, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and anti-cancer properties.
